name: dscoll_lane_e_ltr-geom-COMMIT
purpose: COORD 07:21 safe geometry: 43.2um SRAM origins, full-face outer pins <=6/um, one north std-cell band, central core-face clock beside register mass. S81-SAFE-FIX/COLL (10-19, SAFE-AUDIT-S81 row dsfd_coll_lane_w: items 3/1/7): structural fix of the reset / select fan-out on the HF-3 ltr kit (cxea3 geometry, E exact MY mirror). RTL SAFE 1 (tile-top default): the single reset synchroniser flop u.rst_s[1] drove 6,837 loads (939 async clears + ~5,750 rst-gated hold enables of the ep frame data) -> ot_rst_relay 5 kept per-consumer copies, rx beat landing reset only on its 3 flag bits, ot_s81ph_link_ep DNR 1 (frame data registers reset-free), LCR landing read pointer rp (4,426 loads) kept per 8-bit slice (ot_link_credit_rx RREP 70). Kit: reset_landing 2 stages at the N face, io_hold_margin 0.03, tf forwarded-clock SDC (HF-3b). 0 data cycles; reset release +3 edges.
